RealESRGAN_x4plus.description: General-purpose 4x upscaler. Best default for photographs.

RealESRGAN_x4plus_anime_6B.description: 6-block variant tuned for illustration and anime line art. Faster than x4plus.

RealESRGAN_x2plus.description: Native 2x upscaler. Used for the 2x preset and as the second pass of 8x.

realesr-general-x4v3.description: Compact 4x model. Paired with the wdn variant it provides a real denoise-strength control via DNI weight interpolation.

realesr-general-wdn-x4v3.description: Denoising counterpart of realesr-general-x4v3. Not selectable on its own; blended with its pair by the denoise-strength control.
